Sanitary Sewer Overflow Reported on April 27, 2026 5678 Sample St

Around 8:30 on the 27 of April, Water Pollution Control was notified of sewage coming out of a manhole flowing into a storm box. Bypass system ended at 11:30 am. Water Pollution Control Estimated 9000 gallons of wastewater was released from the system. Creek will be tested to determine if the E-Coli levels in the creek are within acceptable limits set by KDHE.
